# Piano

> A free desktop piano for Windows, macOS and Linux (Electron, React, Web Audio) that plays
> scores as notes falling onto an on-screen keyboard or as sheet music, and teaches them: a
> wait mode, grading per note gathered by bar and section rather than a percentage, and a
> drill whose tempo climbs after a clean repetition. It ships with a Claude Code plugin: an
> MCP server whose tools write a score in the piano score format, validate it, keep it in a
> local library and play or practise it in the open window. No account, no telemetry; the
> library, practice history and settings are local files.

## For agents

Every route has a Markdown twin beside it, the same page converted from the same render with
the navigation, the footer and the calls to action dropped. Read `<route>/index.md` instead of
the HTML: the landing page is [`/index.md`](https://alegauss.github.io/piano/index.md). The
routes, their twins and their sizes are in
[`manifest.json`](https://alegauss.github.io/piano/manifest.json).

The tool and command names on these pages are read out of the plugin's source when the site
is built, so they are the ones the server registers. The full list, each with the first
sentence of its own description, is on
[`/claude-code/index.md`](https://alegauss.github.io/piano/claude-code/index.md).

## Install the plugin

In Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add alegauss/piano
/plugin install piano@piano
```

The server ships inside the plugin and needs only Node. Whether there is an app release to
download, and for which systems, is stated on the landing page's install section, which is
derived from the repository's tags when the site is built.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://alegauss.github.io/piano/index.md): what it is, who does what, the rules
  it is built on, the roll, practice, the library, non-goals, install.
- [Claude Code](https://alegauss.github.io/piano/claude-code/index.md): the commands, the
  tools, the loop the score-writing skill follows, what the server refuses.
- [Falling notes](https://alegauss.github.io/piano/features/falling-notes/index.md)
- [Sheet music](https://alegauss.github.io/piano/features/sheet-music/index.md)
- [Practice](https://alegauss.github.io/piano/features/practice/index.md)
- [The library](https://alegauss.github.io/piano/features/library/index.md)
- [The score format](https://alegauss.github.io/piano/features/score-format/index.md), with
  the head of a score the app ships.
